<?php
/**
 * Temporary stub for isolated index.php opcode dump — DO NOT KEEP
 */
if (!defined('DS')) define('DS', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR);
if (!defined('PATH_BASE')) define('PATH_BASE', dirname(__FILE__) . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR);
if (!defined('PATH_CORE')) define('PATH_CORE', PATH_BASE . 'bff' . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR);
if (!defined('PATH_PUBLIC')) define('PATH_PUBLIC', PATH_BASE . 'public_html' . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR);
if (!defined('BFF_PRODUCT')) define('BFF_PRODUCT', 'do');
if (!defined('BFF_VERSION')) define('BFF_VERSION', '2.4.6-stub');

// minimal class so any late calls do not fatal
class bff {
    public static function i() { static $i; return $i ? $i : $i = new self(); }
    public function init() {}
    public static function device($a=0,$b=false){ return 'desktop'; }
    public static function adminPanel(){ return false; }
    public static function cron(){ return false; }
}
